_about: Posting grids per Page, from the Clark Bros Media network's own tested schedule: at most one feed post an hour, 06:00–21:00, stories on the half hours. Times are the Page's local time. Each item is [time, type]. Reels and image reels arrive in an update; until then those slots are skipped.
offset_rule: Give each Page its own offset of 0–25 minutes (Page 1 +0, Page 2 +5, …) so a network's Pages don't all post at the same minute.
